title: Antarctic ozone hole, greatest single-day extent (million sq km)
notes: Greatest one-day extent of the Antarctic ozone hole each year, from NASA/NOAA satellite ozone monitoring. 2000: record single-day extent of 29.9 million sq km (Sept 29, 2000). 2015: peak of 28.2 million sq km (Oct 2, 2015). 2024: peak of 22.4 million sq km (Sept 28, 2024), ranked 7th-smallest since recovery began in 1992. 2025: peak of 22.86 million sq km (Sept 9, 2025), ranked 5th-smallest since 1992; rounded to 22.9 for display.
